authorization_source: User instruction 'tiến hành bước tiếp' after completion of the Text Model Direction V4 evidence synthesis.
research_question: Can one frozen sentence-level semantic representation improve cross-source label discrimination over the frozen word TF-IDF baseline without increasing measurable source/style dependence?

hypothesis_origin.interpretation_limit: Opened internal test and Wayback V1/V2/V3 evidence may motivate a materially different semantic representation, but none may select an encoder, classifier, threshold or hyperparameter.

selection_basis: English scope matching this internal experiment
small frozen encoder feasible on the available machine
at least 512-token model context preferred for heterogeneous source text
officially documented feature-extraction or classification usage

candidates_reviewed.reason: The 256-token limit discards more long-form content than the available 512-token alternatives.
It meets the size and license screen, but E5 has an explicit official instruction for using a query prefix when embeddings are linear-probing features, which yields a clearer frozen contract.

runtime.license_conclusion: No restrictive license was identified among the selected model and direct model-loading dependencies. Preserve notices and attribution when redistributing model or software artifacts.

text_to_embedding_contract.prefix_reason: The pinned model card explicitly prescribes query: when embeddings are used as linear-probing classification features.
text_to_embedding_contract.pooling: Set padded token vectors to zero using attention_mask, sum token vectors, divide by attention-mask token count.
text_to_embedding_contract.normalization: row-wise L2 norm with p=2 after mean pooling
text_to_embedding_contract.row_order: ascending record_id within each requested partition
text_to_embedding_contract.cache_reuse_rule: Reuse only if every key field and expected matrix shape matches; otherwise stop rather than silently recompute into the same path.

development_design.method: deterministic four-fold grouped out-of-fold comparison within the original train partition
development_design.assignment: Within each source_dataset and source label stratum, sort complete split_group_id values by SHA-256(seed|group_id), then assign round-robin to folds. A group is never split.
development_design.baseline_representation: Frozen Text Baseline V2 word TF-IDF unigram+bigram settings fit separately inside each fold.
development_design.confirmation_rule: Only after complete development OOF predictions and diagnostics exist, fit both frozen representations on all train rows and score the existing validation partition once.

fixed_classifier.reason: Use the frozen baseline classifier and threshold so the single planned change is the representation.

selection_policy.if_any_development_gate_fails: Retain ISI_TEXT_BASELINE_V2 and do not access validation, internal test or external benchmarks for this challenger.
selection_policy.if_development_passes_but_any_validation: Retain ISI_TEXT_BASELINE_V2; retire this exact semantic challenger; do not access internal test or external benchmarks.
selection_policy.if_all_gates_pass: Freeze a validation-confirmed research candidate only. Internal test remains closed, deployment remains prohibited, and headline external evaluation requires a newly collected untouched evidence-backed cohort.

diagnostics.source_predictability_classifier: LogisticRegression with C=2.0, liblinear, max_iter=2000, random_state=20260916 evaluated OOF on the same grouped folds

known_limitations: E5-small-v2 is English-only; this protocol does not evaluate multilingual behavior.
Texts longer than 512 tokens are right-truncated, so late-page evidence may be lost.
Mendeley source label 1 is not regulator-verified investment-scam ground truth.
Frozen general-purpose embeddings may still encode source, genre and marketing style.
CPU execution improves local reproducibility but may be slow.
prohibited_interpretations: Do not call the output score a real-world investment-scam probability.
Do not claim semantic embeddings are superior before all predeclared gates are evaluated.
Do not compare alternative encoders on validation after this freeze.
Do not use opened Wayback V1/V2/V3 records to tune this challenger.
Do not open the internal test or create a deployable model artifact in this stage.
next_gate: Implement and independently verify deterministic offline embedding generation and OOF-only development evaluation exactly as frozen here; stop before validation unless every development gate passes.
